_nota: Feedback texts in English. Same structure as texts.json. Warm tone, no clinical labels, always something the person can do (RNF10).
verde_positivo: Your text feels light today, and that's great. I've saved the entry. If you like, jot down one good thing from today to reread on heavier days.
verde_neutro: Thank you for writing today. I've saved the entry, and you're close to your usual self. How about a short break to stretch your body?
amarelo_geral: I noticed you're a bit away from your usual self today. It's worth trying the suggestion below, it's quick.

amarelo_tema.cansaco_sono: It seems tiredness is weighing on you. Shall we try a simple sleep routine today? The suggestion is right below.
amarelo_tema.ansiedade: I noticed worry and tension in your text. A guided 3-minute breathing exercise may help right now. The suggestion is below.
amarelo_tema.humor_baixo: It seems your spirits are low today. An activity you enjoy, scheduled for today, may help. See the suggestion below.
amarelo_tema.saudade_isolamento: Homesickness showed up in your text. A message home or some time with the crew can warm up the day. See below.
amarelo_tema.conflito: It seems things are tense with the crew. Some time alone and a calm conversation afterwards may help. See the guide below.
amarelo_tema.sobrecarga: It seems the tasks are piling up. A break and three priorities for today may ease it. The suggestion is below.
amarelo_tema.monotonia: The days seem all alike. A new activity can break that repetition. See the suggestion below.

vermelho_tema.cansaco_sono: Your last few days have been heavy, with a lot of tiredness. This deserves care.
vermelho_tema.ansiedade: Your last few days have been full of worry and tension. This deserves care.
vermelho_tema.humor_baixo: Your last few days have been marked by very low spirits. This deserves care.
vermelho_tema.saudade_isolamento: Your last few days have been full of homesickness and loneliness. This deserves care.
vermelho_tema.conflito: Your last few days have been full of tension with the crew. This deserves care.
vermelho_tema.sobrecarga: Your last few days have been very overloaded. This deserves care.
vermelho_tema.monotonia: Your last few days have been very monotonous. This deserves care.

vermelho_geral: Your last few days are much heavier than your usual. This deserves care.
escalonamento: Please talk to the crew's medical officer today, calmly. In the meantime, the suggestion below may help. A summary, without your text, goes to Earth as soon as the link allows.

amarelo_recuperacao: Good to see you feeling better today. Over the last few days {tema} weighed a lot, so it's worth keeping a light level of care. The suggestion is below.
